dataset.name: inputdata synthetic documents
dataset.limitations: Manifest truth candidates; offline reference responses are not LLM accuracy. No OCR. Duplicate relevance is unannotated; no duplicate accuracy claim.

definitions.quality_metrics: Known normalized truth only; failures remain in denominators. Unknown truth coverage is explicit.
definitions.automatic: All outputs before EDIT/APPROVE; no products saved.
definitions.calls: Service calls; SDK transport retries are not counted separately.
definitions.confidence: Null scores / observed non-null normalized AI attributes. Unproduced attributes are outside this score-only denominator; quality metrics still penalize missing known truth. No calibrated probability claim.

limits.semantics: Checked before each service call; in-flight SDK calls retain configured timeout/retries.
